name: AH 3289
title: Research in Allied Health Sciences
description: Provides students in the department of Allied Health Sciences research experience under the guidance and supervision of a department faculty member; designed to engage a student in inquiry and investigation on a topic of interest. Guidelines, learning agreement, and supporting documentation required. Students may only count a maximum combined credit total of six credits toward the Allied Health major of international study, independent study, internship, and research credits. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: Open only with consent of instructor, advisor, and department head.
